_source: Shape of the PortalVpnGroupDevices query (twingate.ts). Field names from the Twingate Admin API schema, https://www.twingate.com/docs/api (Group.users, User.devices, Device.osName / deviceType / activeState / lastSuccessfulLoginAt). Device values copied from the device_edge example in Twingate's CLI tests, https://github.com/Twingate-Labs/Twingate-CLI/blob/main/tests/conftest.py (CLI linked from https://www.twingate.com/docs/introduction-to-the-python-cli). Group/user ids and cursors are placeholders; tests derive ARCHIVED / BLOCKED variants from this device.
